an7.75:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hoti.
an7.75:1.7: sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati, ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an7.75:1.8: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an7.75:1.9: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.75:1.10: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu vinayadharo hotīti.
